high_concept: Undead technomancers who fuse bone, shadow, and arcane machinery. They command revenants, harvest soul-energy, and weaponize decay with precise control.

silhouette.description: Tall or looming shapes with draped robes, jutting bone armor, and angular tech protrusions. Often asymmetrical due to grafts or floating components.
rules: Integrate hard tech geometry with organic decay; cables can substitute for sinew.
Glows and runes should feel purposeful, like circuitry powering rituals.

mechanical_identity.secondary_resource_notes: Wind represents siphoned soul-force; meat appears when using living sacrifices or regrowth effects.

special_flags_usage.biological: Rare—mostly for freshly raised ghouls or living cultists.
special_flags_usage.mechanical: Common for lich-tech constructs and armored husks.
special_flags_usage.resist: Reserved for shielded phylactery units or armored constructs.
special_flags_usage.no_unwind: Used on relentless undead that never tire or on bound spirits.
